description: This source file defines the NotInOperator class, which is a filter operator used in the SuiteCRM system to represent the 'NOT IN' comparison in filters and SQL queries. It extends a base Operator class and implements an OperatorInterface, providing methods to return filter tags, SQL operators, validate inputs, and format SQL operands.

classes.name: NotInOperator
classes.description: A filter operator class representing the 'NOT IN' comparison used for filtering data and generating SQL queries in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'nin' used in JSON API filters.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string 'NOT IN'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided operator string is valid for this operator, expecting a string input.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Formats the array of operands into an SQL operand string enclosed in parentheses.
